caption: The drawing depicts a single, oval-shaped black metal tub with two symmetrical handles on each end. The tub is decorated with a red, wavy horizontal stripe bordered by a thin yellow line near the upper edge, running along the inner rim. On the inner surface at the base of the tub, there are painted decorations consisting of what appears to be two red-orange shapes, possibly intended as stylized fruit, surrounded by green and yellow leaf-like forms. Inside each handle, there is a yellow decorative motif that resembles a fan or a stylized leaf. The tub is set against a plain, light cream-colored background. The drawing is signed “Mildred Ford” in small letters in the bottom left corner.
title: Bread Tray
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
